about.title: About Shui
about.p1: Shui is a free, AI-assisted personal energy cycle analysis tool. We translate classical environmental algorithms and temporal philosophy into modern energy cycle insights — chronobiological rhythms, seasonal resonance, and spatial harmony strategies.
about.p2: All analyses are generated by large language models based on classical references (San Ming Tong Hui and Zi Ping Zhen Quan). They are NOT predictions, advice, or guarantees. Think of them as 'weather forecasts' for your personal energy levels.
about.p3: The site is free to use. We may earn a small affiliate commission when you purchase recommended resources — this never affects the analysis itself.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.privacy.q1: Do you keep my personal birth details on your servers?
faq.privacy.a1: No. We enforce a strict Zero-Knowledge Data Policy. Your birth timestamp is used exclusively in real-time memory to compute your energy spectrum. Once generated, all personal input vectors are automatically purged from our temporary servers within 24 hours.
faq.privacy.q2: How long can I access my generated report online?
faq.privacy.a2: Due to our privacy-first automatic cleanup system, live report links expire within 24 hours. We strongly recommend downloading or saving your report as a PDF immediately after viewing.
faq.science.q3: How does a classical rhythm algorithm relate to modern energy cycles?
faq.science.a3: Ancient environmental systems (such as classical Asian spatial literature) mapped how human physiology and psychology interact with seasonal and temporal changes. We translate these intricate time-and-element relationships into modern energy cycle metrics, helping you understand when to push forward and when to rest.
faq.science.q4: Can this report predict my exact future or make financial decisions for me?
faq.science.a4: No. Future outcomes depend on individual choices, actions, and real-world conditions. Our reports do not predict fixed outcomes. Instead, they provide a 'weather forecast' for your personal energy levels, giving you environmental strategies to navigate challenging phases smoothly.
faq.purchase.q5: Are the recommended items (crystals, lamps, decor) mandatory to buy?
faq.purchase.a5: Not at all. Product recommendations are optional tools designed to serve as visual and environmental 'anchors' in your home. You can achieve similar balancing effects simply by rearranging existing furniture, updating your room's color scheme, or adjusting lighting according to the report's layout guidance.
faq.purchase.q6: What is your refund policy for digital books and premium reports?
faq.purchase.a6: Because digital reports and downloadable PDF guides are instantly generated and delivered upon purchase, all sales of digital content are final. However, if you experience technical issues receiving your PDF, our support team will happily assist you in regenerating your document promptly.

disclaimer.short: Science-informed insights for personal growth & mindfulness only. Not advice. Data auto-purged in 24h.
disclaimer.long: This platform utilizes classical environmental algorithms and temporal philosophy to offer personal growth, interior aesthetic guidance, and mindfulness insights. All content is AI-generated and does NOT constitute medical, investment, marital, career, legal, or any other form of decision-making advice. We enforce a strict Zero-Knowledge Data Policy: your birth details are held in temporary memory only to compute your analysis and are automatically purged within 24 hours. Your life is shaped by your own choices.
disclaimer.affiliate: Some of the product links provided in our reports and recommendations are affiliate links. If you purchase through these links, we may earn a small commission at no additional cost to you. We only recommend items that align with your spatial energy recommendations.
disclaimer.dataLifecycle: Privacy by Design: Your birth details are held in temporary server memory only to render your analysis and are automatically purged within 24 hours. We strongly recommend downloading or saving your report immediately after viewing.
